comments.text: Good spot to hitch after crossing the border from Usbekistan. We walked 35 minutes from the border to the spot. A car took my friend, my bicycle and me :)
comments.textFr: Good spot to hitch after crossing the border from Usbekistan. We walked 35 minutes from the border to the spot. A car took my friend, my bicycle and me :)
comments.textEn: Good spot to hitch after crossing the border from Usbekistan. We walked 35 minutes from the border to the spot. A car took my friend, my bicycle and me :)
comments.textEs: Buen lugar para hacer autostop después de cruzar la frontera desde Usbekistán. Caminamos 35 minutos desde la frontera hasta el lugar. Un auto se llevó a mi amigo, a mi bicicleta y a mí :)
comments.textDe: Guter Anlegeplatz nach dem Grenzübertritt aus Usbekistan. Wir sind 35 Minuten von der Grenze bis zum Ort gelaufen. Ein Auto hat meinen Freund, mein Fahrrad und mich mitgenommen :)
